No, that isn't what the output shows. The loss analysis never ran. The zonal statistics tool returned an error saying the source coverage this asset needs hasn't been prepared, and that no observation was made. So there's no result at all, neither "loss" nor "no loss."

The run metadata only lists the setup: Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change and the JRC 2020 forest cover reference, a 2020-12-31 baseline, a 30% tree cover threshold, and a 0.5 ha minimum event size. The asset area is also blank (null).

Treat the asset's loss status as unknown. To get an answer, the coverage needs to be prepared and the analysis rerun. Until then, please don't report this asset as clear of loss.
